schemaNote: Each entry is keyed as "<year>|<company name as in companies.json>" and holds an array of individually-sourced facts. A fact is only added when a specific field (founders, funding, investors, geography, status) is confirmed by a named primary source: the company's own site or press release, an investor's press release, an official STATION F publication, or a relevant government registry. LinkedIn, Crunchbase, other aggregators, or inference are never used as the sole evidence for a fact. For field "status", value must start with one of "Active", "Acquired", "Closed" (optionally followed by ": short detail") so the site can render the correct status pill; verifiedAt records the date the status was checked, not a permanent fact — a status can go stale and should be re-verified periodically.
